QuestInfo.name: Green Mushroom Salad Recipe
QuestInfo.1: Mrs. Ming Ming gave you her new Green Mushroom Salad Recipe. You should run this back to Camila before she gets impatient.
QuestInfo.2: You returned to Camila and gave her Mrs. Ming Ming's recipe. That really made her day...she could barely contain her excitement.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 500 Can proceed to the Salad Ingredients quest

0.0: Here's my latest recipe. I was thinking, wouldn't Green Mushrooms make a great salad? I certainly hope they do...I haven't tried it yet. Take this to Camila, please.\r\n

no.0: You came for the recipe, didn't you? Oh, poor Camila must be waiting so patiently...

1.0: Did you bring Mrs. Ming Ming's recipe? What is it? What is it?\r\n#L0##bI think she said something about Green Mushrooms and salad...#l\n#k
1.1: Salad! Brilliant! Green vegetables are good for your health...so Green Mushrooms must be healthy too, right? Okay, I'm gonna make some for Maya right now!

npc.0: This is my new recipe, for fresh Green Mushroom Salad. Doesn't that sound yummy? I hope it is! Please deliver this to Camila.

item.0: How did it go? Where's the recipe? What took you so long?

lost.0: You forgot the recipe, dear. Don't forget this time. I know Camila's so patient, but you shouldn't keep her waiting.
